title: File system safety
description: Node.js 24 runtime lesson: An endpoint concatenates a user-provided file name onto a storage root, allowing ../ traversal or symbolic-link escape from the intended directory. Includes executable core-module fixtures, a failing starter and instructor regression suite.
objectives: Resolve the trusted root and target with fs.realpath, then check path.relative containment. Do not treat a string prefix check as filesystem security.
Repair node-path-containment and prove a failure boundary.
Describe production risks not exercised by the local Node test.
rubric: I can explain the Node runtime contract for file system safety.
I can reproduce and repair 10.01.05 with real Node core modules.
I can identify a security or load test needed before deployment.
